title: Jamaican Vegan Casserole
description: A flavorful and nutritious casserole made with jamaican spices and vegan feta cheese, perfect for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Cook the casserole pasta according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and chopped bell pepper.
Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the chopped tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the jamaican spice blend and zesty sauce.
Combine the cooked casserole pasta, vegan feta cheese, and sautéed vegetables in a large mixing bowl.
Mix well and transfer to a baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the casserole is hot and the cheese is melted.
